head: criterion
what it asks
rows: more than 20 agents at iteration 2,000, and not stopped as too slow
no agent linked to more than 5% of the others, and 3 to 12 links per agent
one piece, with at least 80% of the agents in the 2-core; no single agent's loss cuts off more than 2% of the world, and no single link's more than 1%
a dimension of 2 to 4, and a typical distance at least 1.5 times its random twin's: a true space, not a folded small world
tokens, links, ages and genotypes spread at least as widely as in B2's median world, and its agents' decisions vary at least as much (effective kinds of staking)
a Gini of the tokens no lower than B2's least even world
